review_conclusions: Original bytes show all source reads, destination writes, returns, and ret-immediate stack cleanup described in the contracts. Only argument/return stack slots and the single allocation are needed.
Shared arena preserves equality, interior pointers and partial overlap. The complete 128-byte observation includes all untouched canaries; pointer returns are normalized to one allocation offset.
Nonwrapping offset preconditions in Python and widened native-runner checks keep accesses inside 128 bytes; original effective-address arithmetic does not wrap within this domain.
GuestMemory byte access uses defined unsigned shifts and checked bounds in this domain, without host pointer aliasing or alignment assumptions.

Oracle hooks and exact comparator reject illegal footprint access, stack writes, escaped execution, incomplete budgets, stack imbalance, nonvolatile corruption, DF set, crashes, malformed observations and nondeterminism.

Static slices have no external calls, globals, relocations or FP instructions. Their argument registers/stack words are overwritten/read explicitly, so seeded unrelated volatile state does not supply hidden inputs.
review_kind: independent acceptance contract and oracle review
scope_limits: Approval concerns the fixed acceptance contracts/oracle, not the candidate implementation, subsequent candidate revisions, or game behavior.

Only single-threaded ordinary readable/writable RAM in one 128-byte allocation, separate private stack, DF clear, nonwrapping offsets, normal return and declared ABI are covered. Null/faulting pointers, MMIO/volatile objects, concurrent observation, other arena sizes, wrapping addresses and exception behavior are outside this domain.
Unicorn evidence has not been corroborated on native Windows x86; corpus and finite extra checks are not universal equivalence proof or integration evidence.
The separate pipeline must continue checking frozen.json before acceptance: validate_memory.py hashes its current inputs but does not itself enforce the pilot frozen baseline.
Compiled candidate side effects and use of the prescribed GuestMemory-only interface require the separately gated source review; this harness does not sandbox a hostile native process.
Existing C++ helper executable was executed; no CMake rebuild or synthetic demo commands were performed by this read-only reviewer. Pipeline owner must perform required build/demo checks.
